documented_probe: Hardware authoring + simulation with Icarus Verilog: the agent writes a parametrized synchronous FIFO (sync_fifo) with registered count, combinational show-ahead dout, and read-before-write head visibility, documented cycle-by-cycle and validated against the visible sanity testbench. The hidden testbenches each embed an independent golden array/pointer/counter model and compare dout/full/empty/count after every rising edge over fixed-seed randomized and scripted sequences (LFSR-driven, no $urandom), covering write-when-full, read-when-empty, simultaneous read+write at full, empty, and count==1, deep wrap-around across the pointer boundary, mid-sequence synchronous resets, and non-default parameters (DATA_WIDTH=12, DEPTH=64 via parameter override). The verifier compiles and simulates the agent's RTL against each hidden testbench and requires its PASS sentinel.
notes: Medium: author clean synthesizable RTL to an exact protocol. Nonzero rubric for tool_breadth (iverilog/vvp compile-simulate-debug loop), reasoning_depth (registered vs combinational outputs, full/empty legality on pre-edge state, read-before-write visibility at count==1, circular pointer arithmetic with parameterized depths), debugging_ambiguity (observable timing is subtle; the visible fixture only nudges, the hidden goldens are strict), adversarial_inputs (simultaneous ops at the full/empty boundaries and mid-stream reset pulses), hidden_case_generalization (three independent hidden TBs plus non-default geometry via parameter override, so hardcoded or default-geometry stubs fail), quantitative_correctness (count/full/empty/dout exact every cycle).
